name: Webfuse
notes: Webfuse serves an existing website through a configurable proxy session and injects Extensions on the client side without changes to the site's code. Its Automation API, callable from an Extension, provides perception (DOM snapshot, Base64 screenshot of the page, accessibility tree, text selection) and actuation (click, type, scroll, select, key press, mouse move, text selection), targeting an element, CSS selector, point coordinate or Webfuse element ID across shadow DOM and iframes; the screenshot method is documented for Chromium-based browsers only. The Session MCP Server exposes the same tools, plus navigate and page info, to MCP clients authenticated with a Space automation key. tool.applyD2Snap() applies the DOM downsampling method of arXiv 2508.04412, whose second author, Nicholas Piël, is named on the about page as Webfuse's CEO and founder; the about page also says Webfuse grew out of the team's Surfly session technology. The pricing page lists Spark and Forge monthly plans metered in virtual minutes, a custom Foundry tier and a 14-day free trial.
summary: Web augmentation proxy that serves a site inside the user's browser and lets AI agents read DOM, screenshot or accessibility-tree snapshots and click, type or scroll through an automation API and a session MCP server.
